title: 第80章 爱我？那你证明给我看！
novel_title: 唐逸孔诗岚全文完结版
content_zh: 姜云娜见到唐逸羞辱唐画，面色再度阴沉下来。　　只是这一次唐逸没有等她维护的话说出口，当时就已经怼了回去。　　“姜小姐，戏就别演了。”　　“嫁给我？呵呵，你不就是想要帮唐画争取时间吗？”　　姜云娜摇头，红着眼狡辩：“逸哥哥，我……我没有，你，你相信我……”　　铮！　　唐逸手中的绣春刀出鞘。　　姜云娜吓得脸色一白，下意识退了几步。　　唐画脸色也变了，唐敬猛地抬手指着唐逸，声音都尖锐了几分：“唐逸，你还敢拔刀，你想干什么？”　　唐逸偏着脑袋想了一下，道：“我在验证我和唐小姐之间的感情。”　　话落，他轻笑一声，随手将绣春刀丢在姜云娜面前。　　“姜云娜既然对我情深义重，那就证明给我看。”　　“我也不要你干嘛，你在自己的脸上划一刀就行。”　　唐逸指了指姜云娜漂亮的脸，道：“只要证明你对我有情有义，是真心想要嫁给我，哪怕你毁了容，我唐逸必定娶你，如有违背，天打雷劈！”　　“不过，唐小姐可是要想清楚，这么漂亮的脸蛋要是花了，你家画哥哥还会要你吗？”　　少年声音平静，却带着一股不容置疑的威势，姜云娜看着地上泛着寒光的绣春刀，当时吓得脸色煞白，连连后退！　　看着唐逸的目光充满惶恐和愤怒，要我划伤脸？你怎敢这般恶毒？！　　画哥哥最喜欢的就是我的脸，那是画哥哥视为珍宝的东西，岂能有半点瑕疵！　　“不……我不要，我不要……”姜云娜拼命摇头，这次是真哭了，被唐逸吓哭的。　　她求助看向唐画，唐画脸色阴沉得恨不得掐死她。　　愚蠢的女人，看不出来唐逸是在吓唬你吗？你爹和我爹在这里，他敢伤你的脸？你拿刀比画一下，他们立即会阻止！　　结果，你拿刀的勇气都没有。　　这戏还怎么演？　　唐画气炸了，看来对这个女人的洗脑，还不是太彻底。　　唐敬，姜正也是脸色铁青，唐逸扭头看向他们，脸上那是一个无辜：“看到了吧？真情不怕刀炼，姜小姐对我是没有感情的。”　　“既然没有感情，唐侍郎就别生搬硬凑了！”　　唐逸看向唐敬，道：“我明白唐侍郎的意思，唐侍郎是想要让唐画走你的老路，先娶孔家大小姐，获得孔家资源的支持。”　　“等资源用完了，再一脚将孔家踹开，再和姜云娜勾搭……哦，不对，或者说一直和姜云娜勾搭。”　　“不然，唐画又岂能说动姜御史帮忙，毕竟在姜御史看来，三元及第的状元郎，潜力还是很大的啊，大到可以背弃原则！”　　唐敬被戳中痛点，气得脸色泛白，姜正一张老脸更是被怼得通红。　　都被唐逸说中了！　　他们就是这么想的。　　当然这种事，他们是不会承认的。　　“小辈，你放肆！”　　姜正指着唐逸，气到发抖：“今日老夫带着女儿上门，想要延续当年的婚事，那是给你娘面子。”　　“你这小辈，竟然如此无礼。”　　“如此目无尊长，咄咄逼人，亏你现在还是锦衣卫百户，老夫必到陛下面前参你一本！”　　然而。　　面对姜正的威胁，唐逸只是淡淡一笑：“求参。”　　“你……”姜正气得差点当场吐血。　　他号称大炎名嘴，那些王公大臣谁不怕被他逮住小辫子，被他参？　　现在，唐逸竟然直接求着他去参，他姜正的名头，什么时候连个小东西都敢无视了？　　求参？好，满足你。　　“够了！唐逸，你胡闹什么？”　　唐敬一甩衣袖，冲着唐逸冷声喝道：“还不快给姜叔叔和娜娜道歉？他们是为了完成和你母亲的约定而来，岂能容你这般污蔑！”　　他自然早就知道姜云娜和唐画的关系，姜正和姜云娜找上门的时候，他就知道这是唐画的手笔。　　没有揭穿，那是他觉得男人有点手段不是很正常吗？　　当年他为了获得更好的资源，娶了柳如玉，现在唐画为了更好的资源，让姜云娜稳住唐逸有问题吗？　　没有半点问题！　　有问题的是唐逸。　　这混账在胡闹什么？连姜云娜都驾驭不住，他也配驾驭堂堂孔家大小姐？　　“老爷，您别生气，有话好好说。”　　颜霜玉心头已经乐开了花，面上却一副焦急的样子。　　一边拉着唐敬，一边冲着唐逸道：“小逸，你父亲和姜御史都是为了你好，你不要这么无礼，赶紧给你父亲和姜御史道歉。”　　“婚约之事……”　　“婚约之事，父母之命媒妁之言……父母，你们配得上这两个字？”唐逸直接打断颜霜玉。　　颜霜玉面色僵硬。　　唐逸收刀回鞘转身回西院，随意挥了挥手，声音传遍全场。　　“本来我对赐婚没有太大兴趣，对孔诗岚也没有什么兴趣。”　　“但今日看你们的所作所为，我决定了，孔诗岚……我娶定了！”　　本来沈园诗会，他就想走个过场，只要能压住唐画的风头就行了。　　但现在，他要拿这个第一。　　不为什么，就为了气死唐敬和颜霜玉，还要给姜云娜一个响亮的巴掌，给前身出一口恶气。　　“逆子，逆子……”　　看着唐逸的背影，唐敬气得一巴掌拍在桌上：“姜御史，让你看笑话了，放心，这小子和娜娜的婚事我做主，由不得他。”　　这是最简单的破局之法，岂能错过。　　唐逸的意愿？他的意愿和唐家荣耀比起来，屁都不算！　　姜御史脸上的怒容已经消失，他重新坐了下来，手端着茶杯笑道：“都这时候了，就别演了。唐大人知道我需要什么，如今户部两位侍郎都空出来了，我需要其中一个位置。”　　“只要给我一个位置，这场戏，我陪唐侍郎演到底。”　　“反正到最后伤害到的是你的儿子，不是我儿子。”　　姜正抬起茶杯冲着唐敬示意一下，他虽然已经在御史中打出了名声，但相比于御史，他更想做个有实权的户部侍郎。　　这是个肥缺！　　唐敬是丞相一党，但丞相不在朝中，丞相一党便由户部尚书刘温和礼部侍郎唐敬马首是瞻。　　唐敬沉吟了一下，笑道：“可以，不过得等到户部的案子彻底结束，否则陛下猜忌，这个位置你坐不稳。”　　姜正微微颔首，没关系，他等得起。　　姜云娜盯着唐逸的背影，双手紧攥成拳，指甲都镶嵌进了手掌中。　　和画哥哥争锋？你也配？！
content_en: Jiang Yunna's face darkened again when she saw Tang Yi humiliating Tang Hua.But this time, Tang Yi didn't wait for her words of defense to come out and had already retorted."Miss Jiang, please stop acting." "Marry me? Haha, don't you just want to help Tang Hua buy time?" Jiang Yunna shook her head and argued with red eyes: "Brother Yi, I...I didn't, you, you believe me..." Zheng!The embroidered spring knife in Tang Yi's hand was unsheathed.Jiang Yunna's face turned pale with fright, and she subconsciously took a few steps back.Tang Hua's expression also changed. Tang Jing suddenly raised his finger and pointed at Tang Yi, his voice a bit sharp: "Tang Yi, you still dare to draw the sword, what do you want to do?" Tang Yi tilted his head and thought for a moment, then said, "I am verifying the relationship between me and Miss Tang." After saying this, he chuckled and threw the Xiuchun Dao in front of Jiang Yunna."Since Jiang Yunna has deep love and righteousness for me, then prove it to me." "I don't want you for anything, just make a cut on your face." Tang Yi pointed at Jiang Yunna's beautiful face and said: "As long as you prove that you have love and righteousness for me and that you really want to marry me, even if you are disfigured, I, Tang Yi, will definitely marry you."If you violate it, the sky will strike!""But Miss Tang, you have to think clearly, if your beautiful face is ruined, will your painting brother still want you?"The young man's voice was calm, but there was an undoubted power. Jiang Yunna looked at the Xiuchundao with a cold light on the ground, and her face turned pale with fright, and she backed away repeatedly!Looking at Tang Yi, his eyes were full of fear and anger. Do you want me to scratch my face?How dare you be so vicious?!What Brother Hua likes most is my face. It is something that Brother Hua regards as a treasure. How can there be any flaws in it!"No...I don't want it, I don't want it..." Jiang Yunna shook her head desperately. This time she really cried. Tang Yi made her cry.She asked for help and looked at Tang Hua, whose face was so gloomy that he wanted to strangle her to death.Stupid woman, can't you see that Tang Yi is trying to scare you?Your father and my father are here, how dare he hurt your face?If you gesture with a knife, they will stop you immediately!As a result, you don’t even have the courage to hold a knife.How can we perform this play?Tang Hua was furious. It seemed that the brainwashing of this woman was not too thorough.Tang Jing and Jiang Zheng also had livid faces. Tang Yi turned to look at them, with an innocent look on his face: "Did you see it? True love is not afraid of the sword. Miss Jiang has no feelings for me." "Since there is no emotion, Tang Shilang, don't do it mechanically!" Tang Yi looked at Tang Jing and said: "I understand what Tang Shilang means. Tang Shilang wants Tang Hua to follow your old path and marry the eldest daughter of the Kong family first to gain support from the resources of the Kong family."When the resources are used up, kick the Kong family away, and then hook up with Jiang Yunna... Oh, no, or keep hooking up with Jiang Yunna.""Otherwise, how can Tang Hua persuade Jiang Yushi to help.After all, in Jiang Yushi's view, the potential of the number one scholar who reaches the third level is still very high, so great that he can betray his principles!" Tang Jing was hit hard, and his face turned pale with anger, and Jiang Zheng's old face turned red with anger.Tang Yi was right!That’s what they think.Of course, they will not admit this kind of thing."Junior, you are so presumptuous!" Jiang Zheng pointed at Tang Yi, trembling with anger: "Today I brought my daughter to the house and wanted to continue the marriage. It was to give your mother face." "You, junior, are so rude." "You are so disrespectful and aggressive. Fortunately, you are still a member of the Imperial Guard. I will come to your majesty to give you a copy!" However.Faced with Jiang Zheng's threat, Tang Yi just smiled faintly: "Please help." "You..." Jiang Zheng was so angry that he almost vomited blood on the spot.He is known as Great Yan's famous mouth. Who among the princes and ministers is not afraid of being caught by him and getting involved?Now, Tang Yi actually directly begged him to participate. With Jiang Zheng's reputation, when did he dare to ignore even a small thing?Asking for help?OK, that’s enough for you."That's enough! Tang Yi, what are you talking about?" Tang Jing flicked his sleeves and shouted coldly at Tang Yi: "Why don't you apologize to Uncle Jiang and Nana quickly? They are here to fulfill the agreement with your mother, how can they tolerate you being so slanderous!" Naturally, he had known about the relationship between Jiang Yunna and Tang Hua for a long time. When Jiang Zheng and Jiang Yunna came to the door, he knew that it was Tang Hua's work.If he didn’t expose it, then doesn’t it mean that he thinks it’s normal for men to have some tricks?Back then, he married Liu Ruyu in order to obtain better resources. Now, in order to obtain better resources, Tang Hua asked Jiang Yunna to stabilize Tang Yi. Is there any problem?No problem at all!The one with the problem is Tang Yi.What is this bastard doing?Even Jiang Yunna can't control her, so how can he control the majestic eldest daughter of the Kong family?"Master, don't be angry. If you have something to say, please speak it out." Yan Shuangyu was already happy, but she had an anxious look on her face.While pulling Tang Jing, he said to Tang Yi: "Xiao Yi, your father and Jiang Yushi are doing this for your own good. Don't be so rude and quickly apologize to your father and Jiang Yushi." "About the engagement..." "About the engagement, the words of the matchmaker ordered by parents... Parents, are you worthy of these two words?" Tang Yi interrupted Yan Shuangyu directly.Yan Shuangyu's face was stiff.Tang Yi sheathed his sword and turned back to the west courtyard. He waved casually, and his voice spread throughout the audience."Originally, I wasn't very interested in the marriage proposal, nor was I interested in Kong Shilan." "But after seeing what you did today, I have decided, Kong Shilan... I am married!" Originally, at the Shen Yuan Poetry Meeting, he just wanted to go through the motions, as long as he could suppress the limelight of Tang Hua.But now, he wants to take first place.For no reason, just to make Tang Jing and Yan Shuangyu angry to death, and to give Jiang Yunna a loud slap in the face, giving her predecessor a bad breath."You are a traitor, you are a traitor..." Looking at Tang Yi's back, Tang Jing was so angry that he slapped his hand on the table: "Jiang Yushi, I've made you laugh. Don't worry, I have the final say on this boy's marriage to Nana. He is not up to him." This is the simplest way to break the situation, how can you miss it.Tang Yi’s wish?His wishes are nothing compared to the glory of the Tang family!The anger on Jiang Yushi's face had disappeared. He sat down again, holding the teacup in his hand and said with a smile: "It's time now, so stop acting. Mr. Tang knows what I need.
title_en: Chapter 80 Love me?Then prove it to me!
